text:
Maya Singh: Brainstorming a low-touch beta for design partners focused on onboarding to Redwood Private. Goal: reduce time-to-first-inference to <7 days. Proposed: 7-day sprint, 4 partners, automated eval harness, minimal infra support.

Ari Patel: low-touch is great for scale. how strict are we on the <7d? need to define blockers.

Maya Singh: blockers = legal hold, network creds, missing metrics instrumentation. Suggest automated scripts for environment checks to catch issues early.

Sam K: automated checks are good. also offer a 45min kickoff call and a 2-hr office hours drop-in in Week 2. keeps support bounded.

Priya Chen: success signals? 3/4 partners complete end-to-end run, avg time-to-first-inference <7d, qualitative >=4/5 for onboarding clarity.

Ari Patel: for instrumentation, require latency and token-count tags. We should also capture model-variant metadata.

Maya Singh: outreach: pick 12 potential partners, screen 6, enroll 4. incentive: $2k credit + co-marketing.

ops-bot: Created tracker: https://confluence.redwood.ai/7day-dp-beta. Assigned: Maya (recruit), Ari (eng template). :white_check_mark: 

Priya Chen: we'll build a simple script that validates environment, runs a canned prompt, and uploads logs. share before outreach.

Sam K: agree. put a clear "what we need from you" checklist in outreach to reduce friction.

Maya Singh: will draft outreach later today. Plan approved unless objections.

Ari Patel: +1. add fallback variant note for on-prem.

Priya Chen: noted - I'll add in the outreach copy.

Maya Singh: thanks folks - will post copy in 6h for quick edits.
